description: This file defines the DataMigrationManager class responsible for managing database migrations within the OrchardCore framework. It includes methods for retrieving migration records, updating features, uninstalling features, and executing migration steps, including create, upgrade, and uninstall methods, with support for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: DataMigrationManager
classes.description: Manages database migrations, including retrieving migration records, updating features, executing create, upgrade, and uninstall methods, with support for asynchronous operations.

methods.name: GetDataMigrationRecordAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the current data migration record, creating and saving it if it does not exist.

methods.name: GetFeaturesThatNeedUpdateAsync
methods.description: Returns a list of feature IDs that require migration updates based on current migration versions.

methods.name: Uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a feature by executing its uninstall methods and removing related migration records.

methods.name: UpdateAllFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Automatically updates all features that need migration updates.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates specified features by their IDs, handling dependencies and migration steps.

methods.name: UpdateAsync (private)
methods.description: Performs migration updates for a specific feature, executing create and upgrade methods as needed.

methods.name: InvokeCreateOrUpdateMethodAsync
methods.description: Invokes a migration method that returns either Task<int> or int, handling asynchronous execution.

methods.name: GetDataMigrationRecordAsync (private)
methods.description: Retrieves the data migration record for a specific migration instance.

methods.name: GetDataMigrations
methods.description: Returns all IDataMigration instances associated with a specific feature.

methods.name: CreateUpgradeLookupTable
methods.description: Creates a dictionary mapping migration version numbers to corresponding update methods.

methods.name: GetUpdateFromMethod
methods.description: Extracts version number and method info from methods named with 'UpdateFrom' prefix.

methods.name: GetCreateMethod
methods.description: Finds the 'Create' or 'CreateAsync' method in a migration class.

methods.name: GetUninstallMethod
methods.description: Finds the 'Uninstall' or 'UninstallAsync' method in a migration class.
